description: Human Space Design is a creative and educational game in which players design and develop spaces for human comfort and convenience. Players can plan houses, rooms, offices, parks, and other environments by arranging furniture, selecting colours, and using different designs.
summary: Project details wireless charging of vehicle
details: Wireless charging of electric vehicles (EVs) is a modern technology that allows electric vehicles to charge their batteries without using charging cables. It works on the principle of electromagnetic induction. In this system, electrical energy is transferred from a charging pad on the ground to a receiver coil fitted underneath the vehicle.
